Below is a tracker of healthcare-related executive orders (EOs) issued by the Trump administration, including overviews of each EO and the date each EO was signed.
We will regularly update this tracker as additional EOs are published.
It is important to note that EOs, on their own, do not effectuate policies.
Rather, in most cases, they put forth policy goals and call on federal agencies to examine old or institute new policies that align with those goals.
